texts.Name: Anton Dziatkovskii
texts.What AI projects have you built: I run a production multi-machine Claude agent fleet (6 machines), operated in public: cross-machine consensus, persistent memory, a self-built AI-native CRM, RAG over a 10-year knowledge base, MCP connectors and 100+ automation routines. Open-source flagships across 110 public repos (github.com/tonydzi): claw-consensus (reproducible multi-machine agent consensus with published evals and FAILURE-MODES.md), verbatim-citation-gate (a zero-token gate + burden-of-proof judge that catches fabricated RAG citations, MIT), agent-leash, sqlite-graph-memory, second-brain-starter-kit. Published measured reliability evals (07.2026): 0/17 high-risk actions slipped past the human approval gate in recorded runs.
